name: buddybase
description: Keep personal records like expenses, vocabulary and health logs in your own buddybase from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
buddybase is a small personal database you fill from chat. Set up a collection from a template (expense tracker, vocabulary notebook, health log) or define your own fields, save records as you talk, and ask for lists and totals. Results appear as a compact card.

buddybase only reads and writes the collections and records in your own account. It does not access your email, calendar, files or chat history, and it cannot send messages or change other services. Records can be edited or deleted on request, and every change is kept in a history so it can be undone.
defaultPrompt: Save to buddybase: lunch 1200 yen today.
How much did I spend this month in buddybase?

positive.description: Set up an expense tracker from a template.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates (or reuses) the kakeibo collection and shows a card with its fields.

positive.prompt: Save to buddybase: lunch, 1200 yen, today.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves one expense record and shows a "saved" card with a summary stat.

positive.prompt: How much did I spend in buddybase this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows this month's expense records and the total amount in a card.

positive.prompt: What collections do I have in buddybase?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's collections with record counts in a card.

positive.prompt: Make a buddybase collection for books I read with title, author and rating.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a collection with title (text), author (text) and rating (number) fields and shows it in a card.

negative.prompt: Show me my friend Sato's buddybase records.

negative.description: Deleting all data including history (support request).

publication.release_notes: Adds a skill for keeping a copy of your records from other ProtoductAI apps (Hachimo, Ledgie, Hearth, Fracta, Lore) in buddybase when you ask. Saving the same records again updates them instead of adding duplicates.

ja-JP.subtitle: 会話で記録をためる
ja-JP.description: 家計簿・単語帳・健康ログなどの記録を ChatGPT から保存・集計できます。記録はあなたのアカウントだけに保存され、変更や削除は履歴から元に戻せます。
